editorial.blurb: Chengdu Impression delivers authentic Sichuan cuisine with bold, well-balanced flavors and standout dishes that keep diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Come on a Friday night when it's busy—you'll still get a table in under 10 minutes and your dishes arrive within 10 minutes of ordering; the noodle and fried dishes are noticeably better eaten in-house rather than takeout.
